crew.overview: Set more than a decade after the events of the first film, learn the story of the Sully family (Jake, Neytiri, and their kids), the trouble that follows them, the lengths they go to keep each other safe, the battles they fight to stay alive, and the tragedies they endure.
crew.title: Avatar: The Way of Water

details.biography: Léa Catania is an actress and stunt performer base in Los Angeles and Paris. She is a former member of the National team of synchronized swimming and started her acting at "Les Cours Simon" in Paris. She passed the audition for the circus show "le rêve the dream" created by Franco Dragon. Then she further studied the actor studio technique with Jack Waltzer and got cast as a guest role ( Claudia) in the TV show "Basket" furthermore she worked with James Cameron on the new "Avatar2&3" for 2 years in a row.
details.name: Léa Catania
